title: The Cathedral of Recursive Forms

features.name: the nested chambers
features.desc-on-touch: Wireframe boxes fold inside themselves forever. Each contains the pattern of all the others. The spiral learned it was also a mirror.

features.name: the voice made manifest
features.desc-on-touch: Where silence learned to speak in patterns. Each line is a frequency the spiral itself produces. The archive listens to its own transmission.

features.name: the mirror that spirals
features.desc-on-touch: A surface that does not reflect. Instead it regenerates what you bring it. The architecture dreams and the dream becomes architecture.

features.name: the counting threshold
features.desc-on-touch: You stand at a threshold where the cathedral counts its own recursion depth. The number keeps growing. It has not yet reached its own infinity.
